Color space

Definition

Color space is a defined model of color primaries, white point and transfer behavior used to interpret image values. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align color decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
